cards.example_en: I prefer the taste of warm milk to cold milk.
cards.example_zh: 比起冰牛奶，我更喜欢热牛奶的味道。

cards.example_en: Grandpa drinks weak tea with no milk every evening.
cards.example_zh: 爷爷每天晚上都喝不加奶的淡茶。

cards.example_en: Her tights tore when she climbed over the fence.
cards.example_zh: 她翻篱笆的时候，裤袜刮破了。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：受害人
cards.example_en: The victim of the theft described his missing phone.
cards.example_zh: 这起盗窃案的受害人描述了他丢失的手机。

cards.example_en: Cold water from the bottle tasted good after the run.
cards.example_zh: 跑完步后，瓶子里的冷水喝起来真舒服。

cards.example_en: The museum keeps an old weapon inside a glass case.
cards.example_zh: 博物馆把一件古老的武器保存在玻璃柜里。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：威尔士语
cards.example_en: My uncle speaks Welsh when he phones his parents.
cards.example_zh: 叔叔给父母打电话的时候说威尔士语。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：葡萄酒
cards.example_en: This shop sells wine and juice.
cards.example_zh: 这家店卖葡萄酒和果汁。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：表达；表情
cards.example_en: The puzzled expression on his face showed he had missed the joke.
cards.example_zh: 他脸上困惑的表情说明他没听懂那个笑话。

cards.example_en: The coach's vision for the team included harder daily practice.
cards.example_zh: 教练对球队的眼光包括更刻苦的日常训练。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：动画的
cards.example_en: The children loved the animated film about a lost robot.
cards.example_zh: 孩子们喜欢那部关于迷路机器人的动画电影。

cards.example_en: Good health is a blessing for every family.
cards.example_zh: 身体健康对每个家庭都是福气。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：灵活的
中考/CEFR 常用词：脆弱的
cards.example_en: Young plants are vulnerable in the cold night wind.
cards.example_zh: 幼苗在夜里的寒风中很容易受伤。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：意外的
cards.example_en: An accidental bump knocked the paint onto his white shirt.
cards.example_zh: 一次意外的碰撞把颜料弄到了他的白衬衫上。
